findings.title: 循环里重试了一次写入，而且这次调用没有幂等键
findings.title_en: A loop retried a write, and that call has no idempotency key
findings.risk: 同一次写入会再执行一遍。
findings.fix: 把第 80 行 `credit(payee, amount)` 改成按原账户和原金额冲正。
findings.fix_en: Change line 80 `credit(payee, amount)` to a reversal of the original account and amount.
